title: Code review and safe change 6
description: Use main.py to identify a bounded change, its callers, and a testable acceptance condition. Do not infer unobserved behavior.

learning_objectives.text: Explain the source role and visible behavior in main.py, src/pipeline.py, tests/test_pipeline.py, web/api_impl.py.
Trace a declaration, setting, or documented claim to a caller, test, or implementation path.
Separate source evidence, documentation claims, and unverified runtime behavior.

practical_outcomes: Evidence map for main.py, src/pipeline.py, tests/test_pipeline.py, web/api_impl.py
completion_criteria: Submit the code-trace exercise meeting all acceptance criteria.
